description: young woman daughter of Perun the slavic thunder god, an archer wreathed in lightning, athletic, long fair blond hair in a braid, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, the highest and most epic form of all, even richer and more splendid than a god, hair and eyes glowing with crackling blue lightning, a golden wreath of oak leaves on the head, no helmet, armour of black steel cracked with glowing lines of lightning, a cloak like a dark thundercloud, a quiver of arrows with blue feathers, holding a great bow of dark oak wood split and scorched by a lightning strike with lightning running along its string, the whole bow inside the image, small bolts crackling close to the hands, fierce and mighty, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same woman: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, even more epic outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
